# NPMSemver v0.1.0 - Table of Contents

npm-compatible semantic versioning — parse, match, and compare versions using npm range syntax (^, ~, x-ranges, hyphen ranges, ||).

## Pages

- [NPMSemver](https://npm-semver.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://npm-semver.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [NPMSemver](https://npm-semver.hexdocs.pm/NPMSemver.md): npm-compatible semantic versioning.
- [NPMSemver.Range](https://npm-semver.hexdocs.pm/NPMSemver.Range.md): npm-compatible semver range parsing and matching.
- [NPMSemver.Version](https://npm-semver.hexdocs.pm/NPMSemver.Version.md): npm-compatible semver version parsing and comparison.
